title: Site Inspector
body:
Site inspector drives by.
On your turn, you may swap your block card for a new one, once.
She'll be back.

title: Light Tremor
body:
Light tremor settles the dust.
Nothing happens. Play the round as normal.
The ground remembers.

title: Rebar Delivery
body:
Rebar delivery blocks your view.
Place your next block blind.
Measure twice.

title: Coffee Break
body:
Coffee break.
Skip placement this round. Everyone draws, then discards their card.
Stretch your legs.

title: Dust Settles Wrong
body:
Dust settles wrong.
The shake runs twice this round.
Watch your footing.

title: Union Rep Visits
body:
Union rep visits.
This round, every block must go on top of another block.
Pride has a cost.

title: Scaffolding Creaks
body:
Scaffolding creaks nearby.
This round, every block must cover at least one outer space.
Stay grounded.

title: Radio Plays Louder
body:
Radio plays louder.
Nothing happens. Play the round as normal.
Everyone's a little more awake.

title: Second Crew Arrives
body:
Second crew arrives.
Before anyone places, the first player picks a player, who swaps their block card for a new one.
Competition sharpens focus.

title: Cracks Spider the Slab
body:
Cracks spider the slab.
The shake runs twice this round.
Brace yourselves.

title: Crane Swings Overhead
body:
Crane swings overhead.
This round, no block may cover the 4 middle spaces.
Give it room.

title: Wind Picks Up
body:
Wind picks up.
This round, no block may cover the 4 corner spaces.
Hold the line.

title: Permit Renewed
body:
Permit renewed.
Everyone draws 2 block cards and places one of them.
Paper over cracks.

title: Foreman Tightens the Schedule
body:
Foreman tightens the schedule.
Place your block within 10 seconds, or skip your placement.
Hurry up.

title: Power Flickers
body:
Power flickers.
The shake runs at double speed this round.
Hang on.

title: Aftershock Cluster
body:
Aftershock cluster.
Before anyone places, the first player runs the shake twice.
The ground isn't done.

title: Structural Audit
body:
Structural audit.
The last player draws a second block card and places a second block.
Prove it.

title: Gas Line Scare
body:
Gas line scare.
Skip this round: no drawing, no placing, no shake.
Everyone holds their breath.

title: Main Shock
body:
Main shock.
The shake runs twice this round, back to back.
This is the big one.

title: Inspector's Final Walk-Through
body:
Inspector's final walk-through.
If the tower falls this round, the loser also gives back 1 point marker.
No second chances.
